narr: North and Central Texas began June with an unsettled weather pattern in place. An upper level disturbance and weak front worked together to generate multiple rounds of showers and storms. Outflow boundaries from earlier convection also served as a focus for development in succeeding time periods. A few severe storms occurred, along with localized areas of flash flooding, and two fatalities occurred due to flooding.
ev: Multiple public reports indicated water quickly entering homes near the intersection of Loop 820 and Trinity Blvd.
Broadcast media reported several high water rescues in the Fort Worth, Mansfield and Arlington areas.
